title: Dropdown menu button for actions
when: The user wants a button that opens a short list of actions, such as Edit, Duplicate, Delete or account options.
prompt:
Goal: A menu button that follows the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern with arrow keys and clean dismissal.
Steps:
1. <button type="button" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="m1">, then <ul id="m1" role="menu" hidden> of <li role="none"><button type="button" role="menuitem" tabindex="-1">.
2. Click, Enter, Space or ArrowDown open with focus on the first item; ArrowUp opens on the last.
3. Inside: ArrowDown and ArrowUp wrap, Home and End jump, a typed letter moves to the next matching item.
4. Escape closes and refocuses the button; Tab closes; choosing an item runs it and closes.
5. Outside pointerdown closes; flip the list upward when getBoundingClientRect shows no room below.
Quality bar:
- The destructive item is last and labeled plainly.
- The menu never clips off screen on phones.
- Items are 44 px tall on touch screens.
Pitfalls:
- Opening on hover only.
- role="menu" for page links, which need a plain disclosure.
- aria-expanded left true after an item closes the menu.
Verify:
- [ ] aria-haspopup and aria-expanded on the button.
- [ ] Arrows, Home, End and Escape work.
- [ ] Focus returns to the button.
- [ ] Outside click closes it.
Output: Menu markup next to its button, menu.css and menu.js wiring every [aria-haspopup=menu].

examples.input: a three dots menu on each row with edit, duplicate and delete
examples.output: menu button More actions, role menu with three menuitems, arrows and Escape, Delete last
